# StatCard

Headline metric: Aleem leads with big numbers everywhere.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.StatCard` · Content

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.StatCard value={…} label={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.StatCard" value="{{…}}" label="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Headline metric block with optional gradient number.

## Props (StatCardProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` * | `React.ReactNode` | The metric, e.g. "<60s", "94%", "$2.4M". |
| `label` * | `React.ReactNode` | Caption under the number. |
| `sub` | `React.ReactNode` | Optional smaller line below the label. |
| `gradient` | `boolean` | Paint the number with the brand gradient. @default false |
| `align` | `'start' \| 'left' \| 'center'` | "start" follows reading direction ("left" is an alias). @default "start" |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>._
